intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “About the fountain. I don’t need a speech. I need to know if you heard me.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I did. It took me a while.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Then tell me what you heard. No flourish.”

options.labelText: “You think that when the jokes stop, people stop choosing you.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “And I hide behind being useful. I’ve done it my whole life.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I don’t want you to earn my company.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “And you said it without a presentation. Not one diagram.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes your hand. Briefly. Then a little longer than briefly.

options.labelText: “Easy fix: stop caring what people think. Problem solved.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Problem solved. Marvelous. I’ll stop at once.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Try me again another day. Bring fewer solutions.”
